payload.summary: Six corrected ledger sources need owner re-attestation after their 2026-09-06 sign-off was invalidated
payload.detail: APPLIED 2026-09-16 (commit 2f7072e43 and its follow-up). Re-read from the publishers' own pages. (1) ranzcp-mood-disorders-clinical-practice-guideline was documentStatus current; the guideline's own RANZCP page states it is more than five years old, no longer considered current guidance, and retained for reference use only. Set to outdated, which moves it band A to B, currency 15 to 0. (2) Five Chief Psychiatrist guidelines (mha-compliance, inpatient-and-community-treatment-orders, examination-locations, treatment-support-and-discharge-plans, further-opinions) carried publicationDate 2025-12-19, which is neither the publisher's 'Date published 1 December 2015' nor its 'Last updated 17 December 2025'. Set to 2015-12-01 with version 'December 2025 revision'. Note on ranking: the date fix has NO score effect. Currency is scored from documentStatus alone (current 15, review_due 8, unknown 4, outdated 0) in src/lib/sources/catalogue-core.ts; publicationDate contributes only a boolean to traceability. Measured, the five score 91 band A before and after. All six had validationStatus locally_reviewed from the owner's 2026-09-06 sign-off, which predates the correction. Keeping that status would have left them out of acquisitionReviewQueue, which filters on unverified, so the re-attestation would never have surfaced. They are reset to unverified and now appear in the queue, at band D until re-attested. REMAINING WORK: owner confirms each correction against the publisher and re-attests.
payload.source: PsychSift Therapy Claude cloud handover session, 2026-09-16, branch claude/vibrant-mccarthy-bbi43k
